outline.heading: Holdout: set it aside before you start

points.text: The main rule of evaluation: some examples are set aside before training and never shown to the model.
Overfitting — the model fits the training examples so tightly that it does worse on new ones.
So for your task, build your own evaluation set — from the same holdout.

outline.heading: How to tell whether fine-tuning helped

points.text: The size of the evaluation set depends on the task.
